html:
Welcome to the official RaggieSoft Backstage companion archive for The Quantum Directive: The Caretakers.

Across its six books (1995–2014), The Quantum Directive: The Caretakers stays anchored to David Vance's lived clinical and transit overwatch alongside Cassandra, Casey, and Elizabeth "Liz" Carter—from childhood ARTS and Capital Transit college expeditions out of Virginia Beach to the top floor of Building 33 in Redmond, 7,000 feet up Ruby Mountain, and the witness table of the United States Senate. Whenever you see a Backstage Bonus Feature card at the bottom of a chapter on books.raggiesoft.com, you can open these behind-the-scenes dossiers right inside your reading view—or explore the full chronological archive below.

Featured Spotlight: Réveillon Under the Mount Hope Bridge & The Senate Witness Table

  • Dec 24, 2004 — The Twenty-One-Day Firewall, Kristine's Blocked Calls, & Permitting the Mount Hope Bridge Réveillon
    How Wendy Vance, Morgan & Meredith Delaney, and Cassandra's legal firewall intercepted Kristine's three-week campaign to ambush nineteen-year-old David during community college finals—and how Marc-André Bouchard and Robert Delaney secured Portsmouth Town Hall permit #2004-1224-MBS to close Mussel Bed Shoal Road beneath the sweeping green steel span of the Mount Hope Bridge for an accessible, sensory-calm 6:00 PM Québécois Christmas Eve feast.
  • Jun 10, 2014 — Stranded at the DCA Faregate: K Street's Motorcade Meltdown, Senator Thomas's Briefing Binder, & The Telescope Emoji
    Follows chief K Street lobbyist Greg from the second the DCA Capital Transit faregates clamped shut on his waist and trapped his four Apex Mountaineers on the 14th Street Bridge while Cassandra, David, Liz, and Casey glided across the Charles R. Fenwick Bridge on the Yellow Line—through the collapse of Senator Thomas's Willard hotel ambush and Chief of Staff Marcus Chen's calm Redmond coffee break during Cassandra's ninety-minute Finch Air and Space Museum theater blackout.

Complete Chronological Index of Behind-the-Scenes Dossiers (1995–2014)

  1. Aug 24, 1995 – Apr 21, 1996 — Forty Polygons Without a Coprocessor: Inside Building 26's 1996 Catalyst Judging Lab & William Keswick's Override
    Why Steve Ballantine had to bite his tongue when seventeen-year-old Cassandra Vance tapped her nametag on the Northwest Pacific University Engineering Quad, how Building 26 kernel reviewers physically disabled the math coprocessor on an 80486 test bench trying to break her 45 KB Assembly rendering loop, why William Keswick personally sealed the unbranded black velvet box, and how NPU Disability Services unlocked an upperclassman one-bedroom apartment for an incoming freshman.
  2. Nov 26 – Dec 24, 2004 — The Twenty-One-Day Firewall, Kristine's Blocked Calls, & Permitting the Mount Hope Bridge Réveillon
    Tracks the three-week Virginia Beach campus escort rotation and Burton Station Road lease severance shielding David during fall finals while Cassandra closed in cash on the Redmond rambler—paired with the Portsmouth Town Hall permit shutting down Mussel Bed Shoal Road beneath the Mount Hope Bridge for Christmas Eve poutine, tourtière, and hot cider.
  3. Apr 6 – Apr 8, 2005 — Alert at Milepost 138: Victoria Vance's Pre-Arrival Threat Dossier on the 'Redmond Vance' Buyout & The Form 709 Ledger
    Steps inside The Prospector's Keep forty-eight hours before the East Coast minivans reached the Lower Motorpool blast doors—revealing why Victoria Vance initially treated Cassandra's triple-rate wire as a corporate reconnaissance trap, how nineteen-year-old Johnny Vance traced Laurent Vance's severed 1924 Virginia branch overnight (discovering three shared April 8, 1985 birthdays), and how Cassandra's W-2 LPN payroll and IRS Form 709 filings kept both fortresses sovereign.
  4. Jan 15, 2014 — Eighteen Minutes Behind Frosted Glass: The Building 33 Board Vote, The v-davanc Orange-Badge Override, & The TAPS Physics Clause
    Inside the frosted-glass Building 33 boardroom as William Keswick and Steve Ballantine dismantle external objections over Cassandra's age (35), outdoor courtyard coding, and MagnaByte mPhone using 98.4% engineer retention math—alongside Corporate Security Directive #B33-0001-MED protecting LPN David Vance's Orange Badge Vault clearance and Vanguard Global's 3:45 PM Fifteen-Ton Chassis Rider.
  5. Feb 14, 2014 — Clearing the Cascades Air-Gap: Meridian's Twin-Rotor Ruby Mountain Extraction & The Courtyard Headphone Protocol
    Documents Morgan Foster's 5:30 AM steam-boiler helipad de-icing at 7,000 feet behind closed State Route 20 winter gates and Meridian Global Aviation's barometric descent profile for Johnny Vance's portable RespiraCore Compressor—plus Marcus Chen's Day-One campus memo codifying Wear What Lets You Build, Equal-Dignity Zero-Proof Events, and Headphones ON vs. OFF alongside Jessica Ragsdale (PROGMAN.EXE) outside Building 35.
  6. Jun 10, 2014 — Stranded at the DCA Faregate: K Street's Motorcade Meltdown, Senator Thomas's Briefing Binder, & The Telescope Emoji
    What happened behind the scenes in Washington, D.C. when four auto-reloading CapitalPass cards left K Street lobbyist Greg stranded at DCA and gridlocked on I-395, Senator Thomas's Willard smear imploded on live 4K monitors, Chairman Hayes praised Nurse David Vance's sixty-second 10:05 AM cold-chain MAR check, and Cassandra answered ninety minutes of K Street panic from the Finch Air and Space Museum with a single 🔭 emoji.
